nick_sales: Heads-up: Zenith wants Dedicated POC in us-central1 but reservation fails with quota + zone affinity error. They need a go/no-go for procurement by EOD.
tara_cs: can you paste the error?
nick_sales: CLI output: ```ERROR 409: quota_exceeded - Requested GPUs (A100) exceed region quota. affinityZone 'us-central1-c' cannot be satisfied.```
leo_infra: two issues: our pool in us-central1 has 2/12 A100 free, and their reservation uses strict zone affinity. If they want strict 'us-central1-c' and it's empty, commit will fail.
emma_engineer: does Zenith need strict AZ for latency or compliance?
nick_sales: they said <60ms p95 and want AZ pin to avoid cross-AZ traffic. procurement asked if zone pin costs more and ETA for strict pin.
tara_cs: quick options to propose: (1) region reservation + soft-affinity prefer us-central1-c (fast), (2) strict zone reservation via capacity planning (2-3 days + possible surcharge).
leo_infra: infra-bot check: `infra-bot: [1841000102] capacity-allocator: us-central1 A100 usage 10/12; us-central1-c fully allocated`
leo_infra: we can reclaim up to 3 A100 from dev pool within 6-8h if approved.
infra-bot: [1841000188] reservation-req: ZEN-req-77 created, status: pending-capacity
tara_cs: also they sent security Qs about KMS and audit retention (3y). Can we confirm?
leo_infra: KMS yes, audit retention configurable up to multi-year. I'll add a note for legal.
emma_engineer: pricing: soft-affinity no price change. Strict AZ reserved nodes will need a hardware commitment and will bump price ~15% depending on term. Finance to confirm exact.
nick_sales: action items: (A) propose region+soft-affinity for demo tomorrow, (B) ask customer if they can accept soft-affinity short-term, (C) if they insist on hard AZ, start capacity planning and quote. I'll request procurement contact.
tara_cs: I'll coordinate SWARM call in 45m with infra and engineering.
leo_infra: starting reclaim request INF-8002 to shift 2 A100 -> us-central1 pool. ETA ~7h.
infra-bot: [1841000299] capacity-allocator: transfer initiated 2/2 A100 -> us-central1
nick_sales: thanks team, I'll message Zenith with options and schedule. :thumbsup:
